items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: he was a fellow named Professor Turo. He was a fine musician.

ctx.x: How long have you been teaching music now too?

Well I've been, I've been in this, let's say about, 1934, since 1934, 33 or 34. See when I came back from St. Louis, there was no work. Depression then. Depression, see I came back in 32. And I believe my, yeah my daddy was here. They went, we were, he was a fellow named Professor Turo. He was a fine musician. I don't know if anybody ever mentioned him, he's a fine musician around here. And through him and my, he and my daddy, while I got to work in the school, through this private school, see. And we had access…
In those days, a lot of the musicians were in that WPA band.
